assertions.title: Test results are parsed and recorded

steps.action: Run compiled test suite and verify parseTestOutput and runIntegrationTests result parsing
steps.expected: TestRunResult.tests contains entries with status 'passed' for passing tests. TestRunResult.success is true when all tests pass.
steps.observed: Multiple tests pass verifying parseTestOutput: jest format parsing (passed/failed/total counts correct), pytest format parsing, generic format parsing. runIntegrationTests: 'returns success when all tests pass' — verifies result.success === true and result.tests.filter(t => t.status === 'passed').length === 2. 'returns failure when some tests fail' — verifies result.success === false with correct pass/fail counts.

steps.expected: Parses stdout/stderr for pass/fail counts, builds IntegrationTestCase entries with status 'passed'/'failed'
steps.observed: parseTestOutput (lines 81-140) handles jest format, pytest format, and generic patterns. buildTestCaseResults (lines 210-245) creates IntegrationTestCase entries distributing passed/failed statuses across files. When all pass, success === true (line 195).

assertions.title: Error handling when no test files generated

steps.action: Run compiled test suite and verify empty testFiles error handling
steps.expected: Call with testFiles=[] returns success:false with error string 'No test files provided to runIntegrationTests'
steps.observed: Test 'runIntegrationTests returns error for empty testFiles array' PASSES — asserts result.success === false, result.error === EMPTY_TEST_FILES_ERROR ('No test files provided to runIntegrationTests'), result.tests.length === 0, result.testFiles.length === 0

steps.action: Inspect source: early return guard in runIntegrationTests
steps.expected: Empty testFiles array triggers immediate return with success:false and error message
steps.observed: Lines 143-150: if (!testFiles || testFiles.length === 0) returns { success: false, tests: [], testFiles: [], durationMs, error: EMPTY_TEST_FILES_ERROR }

relevantTestScenarios: runIntegrationTests returns error for empty testFiles array
